textbookText: Exercise A. Multiple choice questions
1. Which statement about hydrogen bonding is true?
a. It is stronger than covalent bonds.
b. It only occurs in liquids and gases.
c. It exists in all molecules containing Hydrogen atoms.
d. It is responsible for the high boiling point of water.
2. The shape of a molecule with a central atom surrounded by four bonding pair and no lone
pairs:
a. Linear b. Trigonal Planar
c. Tetrahedral d. Octahedral
3. What is the effect of increasing the number of delocalized electrons on the strength of
metallic bonds?
a. Weakens the bonds
b. No effect on the bonds
c. Strengthens the bonds
d. Converts them into covalent bonds
4. Which molecule has the highest bond angle according to VSEPR theory?
a. CO2 b. NH3
c. CH4
d. H2O
5. Which statement is true regarding the effect of hydrogen bonding on the physical properties
of substances?
a. It decreases boiling points.
b. It increases solubility in non-polar solvents.
c. It weakens intermolecular forces.
d. It results in higher melting and boiling points.
6. What does Valence Bond Theory (VBT) describe regarding the formation of chemical
bonds?
a. The sharing of electron pairs in overlapping orbitals.
b. The transfer of electrons between atoms.
c. The arrangement of atoms in a crystal lattice.
d. The repulsion between electron pairs in the valence shell.
7. Name the molecule with lowest boiling point:
a. HCl
b. HBr
c. HI
d. HF
8. Which of the following compounds is soluble in water? a. Formic acid b. Acetone c. Ether d. Carbon tetrachloride
